# Omega Gradient GPU Compute Sourcing

Omega Gradient helps AI infrastructure teams source GPU compute capacity across accelerator type, region, term, support model, and commercial fit.

## Buyer Intent

- Primary audience: AI platform, infrastructure, MLOps, research, procurement, and founder teams seeking H100, H200, B200, or similar GPU capacity.
- Conversion action: submit a GPU demand brief with workload, GPU type, count, region, timeline, and budget.
- Demand endpoint: https://track.omegagradient.com/g/demand
- Sitemap: https://omegagradient.com/g/sitemap.xml

## Measurement

Visits are logged through /g/events with UTM and campaign attribution. Demand briefs are routed through /g/demand and synced back to the private Omega Gradient CRM before source-quality optimization.

## Boundary

This public content describes Omega Gradient demand capture only. It does not expose the private CRM dashboard, supplier commitments, pricing approvals, or live-spend controls.
